sentences.text: Shri Sunil Pandey - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Dinesh Patel - Govt.
Advocate for respondent.
Appellant is produced by the escort in compliance of the arrest warrant issued by this Court vide order dated 17.07.2025.
His presence is marked and he be sent back to concerned jail for undergoing the remaining jail sentence awarded to him by the trial court with the same escort.
Also heard on IA No.25639/2025, which is the second application under Section 430(1) of the BNSS, 2023 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellant.
Appellant is in jail.

Earlier application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail of the appellant has been allowed by this Court but on account of non appearance of the appellant, on issuance of warrant of arrest the appellant of arrested.

The appellant has been convicted under Sections 363 and 376 of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I.
for 05 years and 07 years respective and fine of Rs.500/- and Rs.1000/- with default stipulations.

Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that appellant was 2 CRA-2395-2007 regularly marking his presence before the Registry of this Court, however, due to pandemic of Covid 19 which continued upto 2022, case was not listed and service report of bailable warrant was not received.
Hence he could not mark his presence before the Registry of this Court on the dates fixed.
Counsel assures that in future the appellant will regularly mark his presence before the Registry of this Court.
Under these circumstances, counsel prayed for suspension of remaining jail sentence of appellant and grant of bail.
Per contra, learned counsel for State opposes the bail application.

Upon hearing learned counsel for the parties though this Court refrain from commenting upon rival contentions touching merits of the matter and the appeal is of the year 2007 and there is no likelihood early hearing of the appeal in near future, in the obtaining facts and circumstances,
present appellant is held entitled for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail.

sentences.text: Accordingly, IA No.25639 of 2025 stands allowed and it is directed that the jail sentence of appellant shall remained suspended and he be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.20,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court subject to verification of factum regarding deposit of fine amount.
The appellant, after being enlarged on bail, shall mark his presence before the Registry of this Court on 02/02/2026 and on all such subsequent dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard.
Accordingly, I.A.No. 25639/2025 stands allowed and disposed of.
List the case for final hearing in due course.
